content: Section 11 focuses on the management of chronic kidney disease (CKD) in individuals with diabetes. It provides detailed guidelines and evidence-based recommendations for the screening, diagnosis, and treatment of CKD in this population. The section emphasizes the importance of early detection and intervention to slow the progression of kidney disease and reduce associated complications. Additionally, the section addresses the need for multidisciplinary care and patient-centered approaches to optimize treatment adherence and overall health outcomes.
